title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the maximum work obtainable from the engine.

title: Entropy Change
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the change in entropy for the system during the process.

title: Reversibility Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the condition for maximum work in terms of reversibility and entropy.

title: Work Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the correct calculation of work in terms of heat capacities and temperatures.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect assumptions about the process.
